'''Ah Ah Kung''' (Chinese: '''孔艾艾''') is an unseen character in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''.

==History==
===Background===
Kung is an associate of [[Wu Zi Mu]] and the [[San Fierro Triads]]. He lives in [[Hong Kong|Kowloon, Hong Kong]].

===Events of ''Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas''===
Kung is mentioned during the mission [[Ran Fa Li (mission)|Ran Fa Li]].

He informed Wu Zi Mu about the up-rise of the [[Da Nang Boys]] in [[San Fierro (3D Universe)|San Fierro]].
